profile.summary: Building Block Interiors is a contract furniture dealership. It offers space planning, furniture buying, delivery, installation and after-sales support for schools and offices. It was founded in 2012 and says it has completed projects in more than 18 states.

review.notes: Homepage lists Oakland Unified among clients, and the company has a Fremont office and furniture services matching OUSD's furniture purchase agreements. The summary, phone, email, website, founding year and 18+ states are supported. The sources give Santa Clara as the headquarters and Fremont as only an office, so the headquarters field is unsupported.
